log: — Fathom Rest · Town —
You stand at The Town Gate.
A notice board by the gate has 3 notices pinned to it.
The Smithy is open for trade and takes crafting work.
The Wrack came in the night: one great tide over everything you knew. You remember the cold, and the dark, and holding on.
You wake on a strange shore, the first tide behind you, the land new and the drowned already stirring. You remember all you learned. Sea-Hardened: +2 DEF.
You make your way to Windy Tavern.
The Tavern has beds for 4 gold a night and a kitchen.
Somebody laughs too loudly at a corner table.
